say:1:1741121001:1.text: Magister Merlin, if you hadn't suggested the dream trial, I really might have gone to Ashvale County...
say:1:1741121001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，如果您没有为我想到梦境试炼的办法，我可能真的...
say:1:1741121001:1.male: Magister Merlin, if you hadn't suggested the dream trial, I really might have gone to Ashvale County...
say:1:1741121001:1.female: Magister Merlin, if you hadn't suggested the dream trial, I really might have gone to Ashvale County...

say:2:1741121002:0.text: I wanted my father to see that I wasn't fragile. That I could deal with danger. That I wasn't afraid to put my life on the line.
say:2:1741121002:0.source_cn: 那个时候，我迫切地想要向父亲证明自己，证明我不是温室里...
say:2:1741121002:0.male: I wanted my father to see that I wasn't fragile. That I could deal with danger. That I wasn't afraid to put my life on the line.
say:2:1741121002:0.female: I wanted my father to see that I wasn't fragile. That I could deal with danger. That I wasn't afraid to put my life on the line.

say:3:1741121003:1.text: But looking back, that wasn't courage. I was just trying so hard to prove a point that I stopped thinking clearly.
say:3:1741121003:1.source_cn: 现在回想起来，那种为了证明而证明的勇气，其实只是另一种...
say:3:1741121003:1.male: But looking back, that wasn't courage. I was just trying so hard to prove a point that I stopped thinking clearly.
say:3:1741121003:1.female: But looking back, that wasn't courage. I was just trying so hard to prove a point that I stopped thinking clearly.

say:4:1741121004:1.text: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.
say:4:1741121004:1.source_cn: 如果真的去了灰影郡，带着那种浮躁的心态，我可能真的会死...
say:4:1741121004:1.male: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.
say:4:1741121004:1.female: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.

choice_prompt:5:1741121004.text: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.
choice_prompt:5:1741121004.source_cn: 如果真的去了灰影郡，带着那种浮躁的心态，我可能真的会死在战场上，也保护不了任何人。
choice_prompt:5:1741121004.male: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.
choice_prompt:5:1741121004.female: If I'd gone there like that, I might have gotten myself killed. And I wouldn't have protected anyone.

say:6:1741121005:1.text: I stayed because this is where my duty is now.
say:6:1741121005:1.source_cn: 我留在王都……是为了承担如今我应当承担的责任。
say:6:1741121005:1.male: I stayed because this is where my duty is now.
say:6:1741121005:1.female: I stayed because this is where my duty is now.

say:7:1741121006:1.text: After everything that happened, I finally understand that keeping the capital safe takes just as much effort as winning battles on the front line.
say:7:1741121006:1.source_cn: 经历了这次动乱，我才明白，王都的和平并不比前线的胜利廉价。
say:7:1741121006:1.male: After everything that happened, I finally understand that keeping the capital safe takes just as much effort as winning battles on the front line.
say:7:1741121006:1.female: After everything that happened, I finally understand that keeping the capital safe takes just as much effort as winning battles on the front line.

say:8:1741121007:1.text: This place needs people to protect it, and people who handle trouble before it surfaces.
say:8:1741121007:1.source_cn: 这里同样需要有人去守护，需要有人去修补那些看不见的裂痕。
say:8:1741121007:1.male: This place needs people to protect it, and people who handle trouble before it surfaces.
say:8:1741121007:1.female: This place needs people to protect it, and people who handle trouble before it surfaces.

say:9:1741121008:1.text: My father gave me the choice. I could pursue a future somewhere far away, or stay here and protect the land beneath my feet.
say:9:1741121008:1.source_cn: 父亲给了我选择的权利。我可以选择远方的机遇，也可以选择...
say:9:1741121008:1.male: My father gave me the choice. I could pursue a future somewhere far away, or stay here and protect the land beneath my feet.
say:9:1741121008:1.female: My father gave me the choice. I could pursue a future somewhere far away, or stay here and protect the land beneath my feet.

say:10:1741121009:1.text: And right now, Savannah needs me here. So I stayed.
say:10:1741121009:1.source_cn: 因为此刻的赛凡纳更需要我，所以我留在了这里。
say:10:1741121009:1.male: And right now, Savannah needs me here. So I stayed.
say:10:1741121009:1.female: And right now, Savannah needs me here. So I stayed.

say:11:1741121010:1.text: But if the Lightbearers ever need me elsewhere, I won't hesitate to go.
say:11:1741121010:1.source_cn: 我想，如果耀光真的到了远方更需要我的时刻，我会毫不犹豫...
say:11:1741121010:1.male: But if the Lightbearers ever need me elsewhere, I won't hesitate to go.
say:11:1741121010:1.female: But if the Lightbearers ever need me elsewhere, I won't hesitate to go.

say:12:1741121011:1.text: And when that day comes, I think my father will be prouder than anyone of the choice I make.
say:12:1741121011:1.source_cn: 等到那个时候，父亲会是最为我的选择而骄傲的人。
say:12:1741121011:1.male: And when that day comes, I think my father will be prouder than anyone of the choice I make.
say:12:1741121011:1.female: And when that day comes, I think my father will be prouder than anyone of the choice I make.

choice:5:0:1.text: So you stayed in the capital?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 所以你选择了留在王都？
choice:5:0:1.male: So you stayed in the capital?
choice:5:0:1.female: So you stayed in the capital?

choice:5:1:2.text: Is that why you stayed in the capital?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 这是你留在王都的原因吗？
choice:5:1:2.male: Is that why you stayed in the capital?
choice:5:1:2.female: Is that why you stayed in the capital?
